summary: Tests three consecutive dwords for all-zero state. Walks a1 element by element; while the current element is zero it advances the pointer and increments a counter, returning 1 as soon as the counter reaches 3 (all three consecutive elements were zero). Any non-zero element terminates the walk immediately with 0.

operations.description: Initialize the element counter v2 to 0 before the walk.
while-loop: while the current element at a1 is zero, increment v2 and advance a1 to the next element; the walk stops at the first non-zero element.
Loop condition reads the dword at the current pointer (field 0x0 of the current element); a non-zero value exits the loop and selects the 0 return path.
Return 1 when v2 reaches 3, i.e. all three consecutive elements starting at a1 were zero.
Return 0 when a non-zero element is encountered before the counter reached 3.
Called by sub_5953B8 (0x005953B8) to check whether the 3-element array it owns is entirely zero.
